Name: Ivan Somodorov
Description: In charge of the Russian mob, Ivan Somodorov imprisoned Ava Anatayla when she was 6 years old. After killing Ava's family, Black Widow came and defeated Ivan. It is because of this that Ava dedicated her life to Black Widow and one day became the Red Widow.
